title: Ryan Thinks Robert Pattinson Is Coming for His Job
description: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond, and the internet thinks he's coming for everyone's job, Ryan's included. Maya explains how Bond is really cast, what Amazon paid for 007, and the economics of superstars: why one actor gets every big role, why stars don't guarantee hits, and why your job is probably safe.

seo.title: Robert Pattinson as Bond: Will He Take Your Job?
seo.description: The internet lost its mind when Robert Pattinson was named the next James Bond, sparking viral jokes about him coming for every profession. We break down the real casting strategy and why Hollywood’s superstar economics completely favor one name over cheaper alternatives. Discover why your actual career is safe and how the economics of fame actually work behind the box office millions.
